summary: 1. One new: the Oct 14 call recorded as "Meeting @Today" (Stage 4/5 priority and equipment deployment with Ali, transcript contains profanity, kept verbatim). 2. New since the morning pass: 261014-INX-SUM.xlsx (read), its mineable-area PDF and broken-stock email (registered by name; drawing and inline-image table), Peter's one-page handwritten "Recovery EOY-2026" plan (ADW 2026.pdf, viewed), and two blank haul-distance sheet templates. 3. No Oct 14 tabs in the production workbooks yet. 4. Survey: Oct 13 production day trucks 22,475 vs survey 16,848 BCM, -5,627 BCM (-33.40%, 15,193 t). 5. Cumulative gap widens to -34,276 BCM (-9.69%, 92,545 t) from -28,649 (-8.50%). 6. Survey MTD 353,875 BCM = 53.46% of 661,986; behind target-to-date by 65,383 BCM / 176,534 t (-18.48%). 7. Required rate from Oct 15 rises to 28,010 BCM / 75,627 t a day, the highest of the cycle. 8. The survey comment names only EXC 6020 (123) on heap and EXC 6020 (340) on heap + 2.5 m. 9. Deployment meeting: Stage 4 first priority, Stage 5 second, Stage 6 only when 4/5 lack blasted material; EX-340 + EX-398 on Stage 4, EX-123 + PC2000 on Stage 5, EX-263 (6015) + 3 rental trucks on Stage 6, 1250 on the ROM pad with Sunny trucks. Stage 4 alone needs at least 14 trucks, leaving about 6 for Stage 5. Rental excavator preference 6015, then 1200, then 395; the room's view is that trucks, not excavators, are the gap. Measured haul distances (Oct 14, survey): Stage 4 to ROM 4.89 km, Stage 5 North 3.00, Stage 5 South 3.62. Hole size debate: start at 142 mm, 165 mm needs downhole drills; about half of drilling is in the wrong places. Night shift (voice note, auto-transcribed): EX-398 stopped 04:36 for a water-damaged ramp, edge cones not placed, two water trucks with punctures, 12,000 target called unlikely. Lost volume uses the 316 BCM/h fleet-average excavator rate (16,440 BCM over 52 h on Oct 13), flagged as an estimate; the EX-398 stop duration is not recorded, so no total is stated. EX-263 cylinder repair (about half a day, taken as 12 h) is about 3,794 BCM / 10,244 t if the unit would otherwise have loaded. Flags, not resolved. (1) The 435,000 and 410,000 monthly targets have no spoken unit; the Notion note says tons, but October's own target is 661,986 BCM (1,787,362 t). Same BCM-versus-tons ambiguity as the Ma'aden letter dispute logged this morning. (2) The Notion project note was still being edited when copied (last edit 13:40); re-check next pass. (3) The Oct 13 survey shortfall's cause is not stated; whether overspill loading outside the survey area explains it needs the Oct 14 dispatch by excavator. Part C (Task Feedback Log). The 40 most recent rows were queried; every row has Status = Processed, the latest dated Oct 10. Nothing to resolve, no task/feedback mismatch, nothing to mark. Part D (Notes & References). 47 rows scanned. Two new rows ingested: Night Shift Handover Summary 2026-10-13, and Project Meeting – Stage 4/5 Priority, Stage 6 Only Under Constraints – 2026-10-14. All other rows unchanged since their RAW copies (edit times compared with RAW date_added). The voice-note transcript clears the dispatch file PTT-20261014-WA0005.opus. Two meeting actions (get actual pit-to-ROM distances; run the updated truck cycle scenario) already existed as inbox tasks, so were not duplicated. The 261014 broken-stock email table and mineable-area PDF were not read for figures. The haul-distance PDFs are blank templates. Workbook Oct 14 tabs had not landed.
